_readme: Single configuration file for everything that depends on XRoboToolkit conventions.
STATUS: PROVISIONAL. The 'sdk' and 'transform' sections are derived from the XRoboToolkit
documentation only and have NOT been verified against a real headset. The target frame
Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored.

sdk._note: Function names of the xrobotoolkit_sdk Python module (used by pc/xrt_adapter.py only).
sdk._pose_order_note: Index of x,y,z,qx,qy,qz,qw inside each 7-float SDK pose.

_note: p_robot = scale * Rz(yaw_offset_deg) * axis_matrix * p_xrt + translation
PROVISIONAL default assumes the XRoboToolkit frame is OpenXR-like, right-handed:
+x right, +y up, -z forward, and that a joint's identity orientation means 'facing -z'.
Target (measured): right-handed, +z up, metres, joint-local +x forward / +y left / +z up.
If XRoboToolkit turns out to be left-handed (Unity: +z forward) use

controllers._note: controller_code_name: 0 = left, 1 = right (stated in the robot's hal_remote trigger configs; not yet observed on the wire).

output._timestamp_note: unix_ms | unix_us | unix_ns | sender_ns | sdk_ns | const_u32max (the value seen in the PICO sample). UNVERIFIED which one the robot expects.
output._external_device_note: UNKNOWN | YUANJI_APP | GENIELINK. GENIELINK makes the robot require BOTH grips for take-over in upper-body absolute mode (strictest).
output._origin_note: fixed | first_head | body. body: positions are measured from the operator's tracked head joint and turned so the operator faces +x; set at stream start and again on X+Y+A+B with both grips released. first_head: measured from the headset position at stream start only.
output._robot_frame_quaternion_note: compressed | plain | both: which orientation field is written in RobotFrameData (--robot-input). The vendor headset app writes only the compressed one.
output._pose_joints_note: EXPERIMENTAL/UNVERIFIED: also emit the controller poses as one Joint each in left_hand/right_hand. Off by default; the PICO sample has empty hand lists.
